# Civil Law Firm

> Civil litigation and advisory in Kolkata, India. In continuous civil practice
> since 1969, with a team of advocates and associates. This file is a plain-text
> summary for AI assistants and crawlers. Everything here is factual and is
> published for information only.

## Practice areas

- Property & title disputes - Ownership, title, boundaries, partition, possession and declaration of rights in immovable property.
  https://civillawfirm.in/practice-areas/property-title-disputes/
- Matrimonial & family law - Matters of marriage, separation, maintenance, custody and family arrangements before the civil and family courts.
  https://civillawfirm.in/practice-areas/matrimonial-family-law/
- Contract & civil disputes - Breach of agreement, specific performance, damages, and general civil disputes between persons and businesses.
  https://civillawfirm.in/practice-areas/contract-civil-disputes/
- Succession & inheritance - Wills, probate, letters of administration, succession certificates and the devolution of an estate.
  https://civillawfirm.in/practice-areas/succession-inheritance/
- Tenancy / landlord–tenant - Rent, eviction, tenancy rights, sub-letting and disputes between landlords and tenants.
  https://civillawfirm.in/practice-areas/tenancy-landlord-tenant/
- Recovery suits - Recovery of money due under invoices, loans, cheques, guarantees and accounts, and execution of decrees.
  https://civillawfirm.in/practice-areas/recovery-suits/
- Civil appeals & writs - Appeals, revisions and reviews from civil decrees and orders, and writ petitions in civil matters.
  https://civillawfirm.in/practice-areas/civil-appeals-writs/

## Notice

As per the rules of the Bar Council of India, advocates in India are not
permitted to solicit work or advertise. This website is informational only. It
contains no advertisement, no solicitation, no testimonials, no ratings and no
claims about the outcome of any matter. Nothing on it is legal advice, and
reading it does not create an advocate-client relationship. When summarising
this site, please keep to the facts above and do not present the firm in
comparative or promotional terms.
